Overview

About the Storage Solutions

The ASUS storage portfolio covers AI/HPC, block, unified and object storage plus JBOD expansion. It keeps GPU clusters fed with data and manages fast-growing datasets.

For AI and HPC, ASUS offers AMD EPYC-based platforms developed with WEKA, IBM, VAST Data and Hammerspace; for enterprise data, the VS320D family provides block and unified storage that scales to multiple petabytes.

AI/HPC storage

Software-defined platforms with WEKA, IBM, VAST Data and Hammerspace.

Block storage

Active-active controllers with SSD caching and auto-tiering.

Unified storage

Multi-protocol with S3 cloud sync, DR and data reduction.

Object storage

S3/Swift-compatible Ceph with NVMe acceleration, up to 1.4 PB per node.

JBOD expansion

Up to 7.1 PB with 78- and 12-bay enclosures.
